name: Picktime
description_en:
Picktime combines appointment and class booking with team and resource scheduling. It can represent people, rooms and equipment, while a public booking page exposes the times customers may reserve. Payments, reminders and meeting links extend that booking workflow.

The prominent free positioning needs plan-level reading: Free has user, location, class and resource limits, and the pricing comparison distinguishes one-way calendar sync from the two-way sync offered on paid tiers. Some advertised features are explicitly marked coming soon.
description_zh:
Picktime 结合预约、班课、团队及资源排程，可表示人员、房间及设备，并通过公开预约页展示客户可预留的时间。付款、提醒和会议链接扩展这条流程。

显著的免费定位必须结合套餐阅读：Free 限制用户、地点、班课及资源数；定价比较区分免费单向日历同步与付费双向同步，部分宣传功能还明确标为即将推出。

core_features.explanation_en: Offer appointments or set available places for classes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提供预约，或为班课设置名额。

core_features.explanation_en: Reserve rooms or equipment alongside the scheduling workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在排程流程中预留房间或设备。

core_features.explanation_en: Free lists one-way provider sync; Starter and Pro list two-way.
core_features.explanation_zh: Free 列出单向服务同步，Starter 与 Pro 列出双向。

en: A training business may need one instructor and one classroom for a lesson, but a group class also needs a participant capacity. Model those separately. Configure booking rules and share the public page, then compare a customer booking with the team calendar and the reserved resource.

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a tutor and a classroom
sections.en:
A training business may need one instructor and one classroom for a lesson, but a group class also needs a participant capacity. Model those separately. Configure booking rules and share the public page, then compare a customer booking with the team calendar and the reserved resource.

Test an occupied room, a full class and a cancellation. The same appointment appearing in the calendar is not evidence that the room was reserved or a waitlist was notified. Those outcomes depend on configuration and the plan; Pro is where the pricing card lists waitlists and booking approval.
sections.zh:
培训业务的一节课可能同时需要教师及教室，而团体班课还要限制参与人数。应分别建模这些条件。配置预约规则并分享公开页，再对照客户预约、团队日历及资源占用。

建议测试教室已占用、班课满员及取消。日历中出现预约，不证明教室已预留或候补已通知；这些结果取决于配置与套餐。定价卡片从 Pro 才列出候补和预约审批。

sections.title_en: What the Free plan actually includes
sections.en:
Free lists three team users, three resources, two locations, two classes and unlimited appointments, with PayPal payments. Starter retains the three-user/resource and two-location limits, increases classes to five and adds reminders, recurring bookings, more processors and two-way sync. Pro lists ten users/resources and unlimited locations/classes. Unlimited appointments therefore does not remove the other ceilings.

The annual USD view lists Starter at $3 per user per month for three users and Pro at $2.25 per user per month for ten users. The apparent lower Pro per-user rate must be read with the larger team quantity and annual commitment. Confirm monthly options, taxes and processor charges before purchase.
sections.zh:
Free 列出三位团队用户、三个资源、两个地点、两个班课，预约次数不限，并可用 PayPal 收款。Starter 保持三位用户/三个资源及两个地点，班课升为五个，并加入提醒、重复预约、更多处理商及双向同步。Pro 列出十位用户/十个资源，地点及班课不限。因此，预约次数不限不会取消其他上限。

年付 USD 视图列出 Starter 每用户每月 $3、三个用户，Pro 每用户每月 $2.25、十个用户。看似较低的 Pro 单价需结合更多用户及年度付款条件。购买前确认月付选项、税费和处理商费用。

sections.title_en: Do not plan around an asterisk
sections.title_zh: 不要依赖带星号的未来功能
sections.en:
The pricing page marks classpacks, vouchers and extensive Zapier integrations with a coming-soon footnote. These cannot be treated as current entitlements just because they appear in a feature list. The SSO note also says automatic enablement is for businesses with 100 or more team members, not every ordinary Pro account.

Calendar direction is another practical boundary: if external appointments must block new bookings, investigate paid two-way behavior rather than assuming the Free feed imports conflicts. Evaluate the exact provider and check the resulting slot after creating an external busy event.
sections.zh:
定价页把课包、代金券及大量 Zapier 集成标注为即将推出。它们即使出现在功能列表中，也不能当作当前权益。SSO 注释还写明自动启用面向至少 100 位团队成员的企业，不能认定普通 Pro 账户都可用。

日历方向也是实际边界：如外部日程必须阻挡新预约，应评估付费双向行为，不能默认 Free 订阅会导入冲突。应核对具体服务，创建外部忙碌事件后检查对应时段。

sections.title_zh: 配置与尚未核实的失败处理
sections.en:
Prepare services, staff, resources, class capacities and opening hours before signup; then connect only the payment or video tools the workflow needs. The product links to conferencing providers rather than establishing that Picktime operates their video infrastructure.

If a confirmation or payment update is missing, inspect the original booking and provider state before creating a replacement. Retry, refund and export completeness were not verified. The material describes a managed web/mobile service, not a confirmed self-hosted distribution or open-source licence. Service organizations can evaluate it, while regulated use cases still require their own contract and data-handling review.
sections.zh:
注册前准备服务、员工、资源、班课容量及营业时间，再连接流程所需的支付或视频工具。产品连接会议服务商，不能据此认定 Picktime 自建其视频基础设施。

确认消息或支付更新遗漏时，创建替代预约前先检查原记录及服务商状态。未核实重试、退款和导出完整性。材料介绍托管网页/移动服务，未证明自托管发行版或开源许可。服务组织可评估使用，受监管场景仍需单独审查合同与数据处理。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Monthly checkout totals, booking commissions/processor fees, SMS policy, resource dependency semantics and contractual licence need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 月付结算额、预约佣金/处理费、短信政策、资源依赖规则及合同许可需确认。

research_gaps.en: No calendar synchronization, booking, payment, resource conflict, AI receptionist or recovery was tested; coming-soon items are not verified available.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试日历同步、预约、付款、资源冲突、AI 接待或恢复；未确认未来功能已可用。
